description: Rewrite the Destinations page (destination.html + destination.css) onto the FEAT-001 foundation. Add a jump-link row at the top (in-page anchors to the six destinations). Render the six destinations (Rajasthan, Kerala, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Goa, Varanasi) with editorial alternating image/text layouts, each with the FIXED id (rajasthan, kerala, himachal-pradesh, uttarakhand, goa, varanasi) so the homepage cards deep-link correctly; each shows best time to visit, top attractions, local food (accurate; no invented hours/prices). Add a 'More to explore' row (Leh-Ladakh, Andaman & Nicobar, Mysore) as smaller teaser cards (no deep links required). Reuse the six destination SVG images created in FEAT-002; create the three more-to-explore SVGs.
steps: Create three more-to-explore images in c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/images/ following the placeholder pattern: leh-ladakh.svg, andaman-nicobar.svg, mysore.svg. No external references.

Rewrite c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/destination.html. Replace <head> with the canonical head block (title 'Destinations — Incredible India', unique meta description, fonts, favicon, styles.css + destination.css, inline `.js` script). Add the skip link, the canonical header (aria-current="page" on the Destinations link), <main id="main">, canonical footer, and <script src="site.js" defer></script>. Match the header/footer/logo byte-identically to FEAT-002's index.html.
Add a page intro heading (one h1, e.g. 'Explore the Heart of India') + a short supporting paragraph.
Add a jump-link row (a nav of anchor links to #rajasthan, #kerala, #himachal-pradesh, #uttarakhand, #goa, #varanasi) styled as pills; it can wrap on mobile.

For each of the six destinations, render an <article id="<id>"> with an editorial alternating layout: image on one side, text on the other; alternate the side per row (odd image-left, even image-right via CSS). Include an <h2> name, a 'Best time to visit' line, a 'Top attractions' <ul>, and a 'Local food' line — accurate, no invented hours/prices. Use the matching local SVG (images/rajasthan.svg etc. from FEAT-002) with width/height/loading='lazy'/alt. Add `.reveal` to each article.
Add the 'More to explore' row: three smaller teaser cards (Leh-Ladakh, Andaman & Nicobar, Mysore) each with the local SVG image, name, and a one-line teaser. No deep links required.

Rewrite c:/Users/aadyagupta/Incredible-India/destination.css for page-specific layout only (jump-link pills, alternating article layout, more-to-explore grid). Reuse tokens from styles.css. Make the alternating layout collapse to a single stacked column on mobile and never cause horizontal overflow.

Remove all Font Awesome and hotlinked images (the old destination.html hotlinks tripadvisor/clubmahindra/paytm/cntraveller/scene7/outlooktraveller/cloudfront). Remove the broken footer links to destinations.html / travel-tips.html.
acceptance_criteria: destination.html has the canonical head (unique title + meta description, fonts, favicon, styles.css + destination.css, inline .js script), skip link, canonical header (aria-current on Destinations), <main id="main">, canonical footer, and site.js deferred — matching FEAT-002 exactly except aria-current.
Six <article> blocks exist with ids exactly: rajasthan, kerala, himachal-pradesh, uttarakhand, goa, varanasi.
Each article has best time to visit, top attractions (list), and local food — accurate, no invented hours/prices.
All images are local SVGs (the six from FEAT-002 + the three new); no hotlinks remain; every has width/height/loading='lazy'/alt.
A jump-link row at the top links to the six ids.
No Font Awesome link, no broken footer links (destinations.html/travel-tips.html gone).
verification: `python -m http.server 8000`; open http://localhost:8000/index.html and click each of the six destination cards — each lands on destination.html#<id> and scrolls to the correct article (confirm the ids match: rajasthan, kerala, himachal-pradesh, uttarakhand, goa, varanasi).
Open http://localhost:8000/destination.html directly — jump-link pills scroll to each section; the alternating layout stacks on a 360px-wide viewport with no horizontal overflow.
No 404s for destination.css or any image; no external image URLs remain.
Disable JS — all content visible, jump links work.
